// A COPY OF THE LINE THAT BROKE room-reader.js, kept as .js.txt ON PURPOSE (B267, 2026-09-28).
//
// It is not .js because every list in this repository that walks JavaScript - the packer, the mirror's
// own lists, the coverage gate, tests/parse-all.test.js's own derivation - would then have to learn an
// exception for a file that is deliberately broken. A .txt cannot be imported by accident.
//
// This is the exact shape written in B267 item 7 (66b4d55) and fixed in item 4b: an apostrophe inside a
// single-quoted string. It was a SyntaxError, so room-reader.js did not parse at all for two days, and
// no suite noticed because no suite loaded that file. tests/parse-all.test.js compiles this text through
// the SAME check it runs over every shipped classic script, so the belt is proven to reject the real
// thing rather than only to pass over files that happen to be fine.
